<b>Solemn Pilgrim</b> is an [[NPCs (Silksong)|NPC]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They carry out [[Pilby]]'s funeral in [[Bone Bottom]].

== In-game Events ==
The Solemn Pilgrim can be found next to the pit in Bone Bottom, conducting Pilby's funeral, if he was killed by the [[Skull Tyrant]] in [[Act 1]]. [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] asks what has drawn pilgrims together, and the Solemn Pilgrim explains that they are there to sing their fellow pilgrim a farewell and mourn their loss.<ref>Hornet and Solemn Pilgrim dialogue: <br><i>Hornet: "What ritual calls you all together, pilgrim?" <br>Solemn Pilgrim: "Our brother, this poor wretch in my arms, has walked his last aching step. We gather here to sing him farewell, and to mourn our great loss."</i></ref>

If Hornet had learned Pilby's name prior to his death, she shares it with the Solemn Pilgrim, who thanks her for sharing it.<ref>Hornet and Solemn Pilgrim dialogue: <br><i>Solemn Pilgrim: "...Hm. Who here knows the name of this little pilgrim?" <br>Hornet: "Pilby. This pilgrim's name was Pilby."<br>Solemn Pilgrim: "Ah, thank you for sharing, sister. For the honourable and steadfast Pilby, we will sing."</i></ref> Otherwise, the funeral is concluded without his name being known.<ref>Solemn Pilgrim: <i>"Well. Though this pilgrim's name has been lost, still we sing."</i></ref>

After the funeral, the Solemn Pilgrim leaves the location and is absent for the rest of the game.

{{TabbedDialogue
|Title1 = General
|Title1_Event1 = First encounter
|Title1_Dialogue1 = {{HTalk|What ritual calls you all together, pilgrim?}}<br>
Our brother, this poor wretch in my arms, has walked his last aching step. We gather here to sing him farewell, and to mourn our great loss.<br>
For though, as pilgrims, we aim our sights high and never waver from our path, the loss of a brother or sister still stops our trembling limbs in place.<br>
Sing, brothers and sisters! Sing, and drown out this burdensome sorrow! Sing out the name of this poor pilgrim, whose journey had nary begun!<br>
...Hm. Who here knows the name of this little pilgrim?
|Title1_Event2 = First encounter (Cont.)
|Title1_Dialogue2 = <b>If Hornet learned Pilby's name before his death:</b><br>
{{HTalk|Pilby. This pilgrim's name was Pilby.}}<br>
Ah, thank you for sharing, sister. For the honourable and steadfast Pilby, we will sing.<br>
Sing for our brother, who has died a devout death! All his pains and torments left behind, like the dust shrugged from a traveller's shawl.<br>
Farewell, brother Pilby. May your shell harden the path for others to tread.
<hr/>
<b>If Hornet never learned Pilby's name:</b><br>
Well. Though this pilgrim's name has been lost, still we sing.<br>
Sing for our brother, who has died a devout death! All his pains and torments left behind, like the dust shrugged from a traveller's shawl.<br>
Farewell, little pilgrim. May your shell harden the path for others to tread.
|Title1_Event3 = Playing the [[Needolin]]
|Title1_Dialogue3 = [n]Fallen brother...<br>
Your journey ends...<br>
We carry your memory...<br>
Fellow pilgrim...
}}

== Location ==
The Solemn Pilgrim can be found near the pit west of [[Bone Bottom]] during [[Pilby]]'s funeral.
